overview:
CCNA – Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) is a widely-recognized IT certificate for professionals who are beginning their IT careers. This certificate validates the ability to install configure, operate, and troubleshoot medium-size routed and switched networks, including implementation and verification of connections to remote sites in a WAN. This certificate is very important for any company. CCNA is the most in-demand certification for IT.
CCNA makes you a well-rounded network engineer, it trains you in multiple levels and areas regarding the ability to work with routed and switched networks. Network Security engineers are in a demandable job now a day and if you are Cisco certified then you have more than 70% possibility to get hired because still Cisco methods are used widely. This strengthens your knowledge and skills in the fundamentals of networking, IP connectivity, security, automation, and more.

reasons.title: Install, operate and troubleshoot medium- sized switched and routed networks
Implement and troubleshoot various protocols to manage addressing, perform load balancing and authentication
Establish and troubleshoot connection to service provider over WAN
Identify security threats and basic mitigation methods
